verdict.rationale: Featurebase advertises generic 'workflows' and 'connect with your favorite tools' integrations, which could plausibly support turning feedback into tasks, but the evidence pack contains no explicit mention of converting a feedback post into a task, roadmap item, or syncing to project-management tools like Jira/Linear. missing for 10: explicit feedback-to-task conversion feature, named PM tool integrations (Jira/Linear/Asana), documented workflow from submission to actionable ticket.
